name: StepIndicator
intro: Root receives ordered steps and the current step number. List can render its children or use the Segments shortcut.

parts.name: List
parts.description: Put ListItem parts here or render them from computed step statuses.

props.name: children
props.description: Can render from computed step statuses.

parts.name: ListItem
parts.description: Pass its computed status to select complete, current, or incomplete styling.

parts.name: Segment
parts.description: Displays the status segment and optional counter.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: Displays a step label when the variant allows labels.

parts.name: Summary
parts.description: Holds a text summary of progress.

parts.name: Counter
parts.description: Displays the current and total steps.

parts.name: Heading
parts.description: Displays a heading for the current step.

parts.name: Segments
parts.description: Renders a ListItem and Segment for every computed step.
